race.description: Cassign - Emerging Stars Series Ht 4 Mdn
race.comment: ZERCARDY (6) was beaten just over half a length when favourite at this venue first-up and should take benefit from that run, while his previous Stawell effort had some early pressure attached. Can improve and takes beating. CIRCUS CIRCUS (8) resumes off two trials, including a close second at Seymour, and she was held in decent regard by the market last time in. Should be ready to go. PIKLEMEGRANMOTHER (11) has been remarkably consistent without winning, with three seconds this season. Off a freshen here but should take catching again. SEMPER AUGUSTUS (12) ran well here on debut on heavy then struggled to repeat the dose on a good track. Gets a softer track now and can bounce back.
